<function name="UseFuncTankBehavior" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<description> Orders the SNPC to control any nearby `func_tank`s looking for an NPC to operate itself, if available. 
<note>This function only works on `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
	</description>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the action succeeded.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
